card.name: Slot before a clause such as is, including
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a noun at the end of a noun phrase, just before a verb or 'including' clause follows. Examples are a comma after a condition, an opening bracket after 'volume-depleted', and 'test' in 'positive methacholine challenge test'.

modes.label: Comma or bracket before 'including'
modes.description: A comma or opening bracket after a patient group or condition, where an 'including ...' phrase follows.
modes.example: Research indicates that patients with impaired kidney function<<,>> including preterm infants and premature neonates

modes.label: End of a test or result phrase
modes.description: The last noun of a subject phrase, just before 'is' and a threshold.
modes.example: A positive methacholine challenge<< test>> is a ≥ 20% reduction

modes.label: Odd name or number pieces
modes.description: A single letter or digit inside an author name or a scripture reference.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed, so there is no clear output effect, though 'when' is suppressed.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a noun phrase where a comma, bracket or verb is about to come, such as after a condition or test name.
